title: Credential delivery
text: The terminal waits while authorization is pending, then finishes on one-time credential consumption, denial or expiry. The engine owns personal decisions and atomically issues and consumes the credential; only one successful poll receives the raw token. Hosted machine_authorization.handoff_poll uses the original device secret and explicit engine org_id under service-only authority, avoiding a shared proxy-address admission bucket. Network loss after delivery requires a fresh connection; credentials cannot be replayed. An install below the handoff serving floor names the control-plane operator rollout recovery. Production review on 2026-10-19 proved personal approval followed by completed terminal activation, a fresh authenticated read and consumed onboarding. Durable request consumption matched one newly created active machine credential that was subsequently used; no credential value was disclosed. Concurrent one-time polling remains source-tested; lost-delivery recovery and below-floor rollout recovery remain unproven in production.
